title: AI tools safety in practice
intro: Use chatbots without leaking information. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: neyrosohbet.example
decisions.prompt: Whose data is in this file?
decisions.explain: A file with personal data is never uploaded to a public chatbot.

decisions.title: neyrosohbet-pro.test
decisions.prompt: Look at the address bar. What do you do on this page?
decisions.explain: A service's "free Pro" version is not handed out on a foreign site.

decisions.title: Use your chats to train the model?

artifact.title: Use your chats to train the model?
body: Your chat history will be stored on the service's servers.

decisions.explain: Turning training off helps, but still do not paste official information.

decisions.title: İdarə Köməkçisi: Your summary is ready

artifact.title: İdarə Köməkçisi: Your summary is ready
body: You can open it on the internal portal.

decisions.explain: The institution's approved tool sends an expected notice and asks for no link or code.

decisions.title: Message from Manager

artifact.name: Manager
body: Hi, it's me. Send the confirmation code to this number right away, I will explain later.

decisions.explain: A voice can be imitated with AI. Call your manager's known number yourself.
